title: Council oversight of special counsel bills and settlements
summary: A council committee voted on June 22 to recommend that the full council adopt a resolution on lawsuit settlements, and the measure now moves to the full council. It would send all settlement offers to the council and have Council Services attorneys review special counsel's bills. A staff attorney confirmed it is approved as to form and legality, and one public testifier said the council must approve settlements.
